Returns & Refund Policy
Brightline Supplies Inc. | Document POL-RET-001 | Version 3.2 | Effective 1 July 2025
1. Purpose and scope
This policy explains how Brightline Supplies customers may return products and receive refunds,
replacements or credits. It applies to all B2B accounts in every region and every customer tier.
2. Standard return window
Customers may return unopened, undamaged products within 30 days of the delivery date for a full
refund. Platinum tier customers receive an extended window of 45 days. The window is counted
from the delivered date recorded in our shipment system, not the order date.

3. Damaged or defective items
Damage in transit must be reported within 7 days of delivery, with photographs of the item and
packaging. Approved damage claims are resolved with a full refund or a free replacement at the
customer's choice, and Brightline pays the return shipping. Claims reported after 7 days are handled
as warranty claims where applicable (see the Product Catalog & Warranty Guide, POL-PRD-005).
Wrong-item shipments are treated the same way as damaged items: full refund or replacement, no
restocking fee, return shipping paid by Brightline, regardless of the 7-day reporting rule if reported
within 30 days.

4. Non-returnable items
The following cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged or defective: custom-printed or
personalised items, opened toner and ink cartridges, opened breakroom consumables, and clearance
items marked 'Final Sale'.
5. Restocking fees
Opened but non-defective returns in returnable categories incur the restocking fee shown in section
2. The fee is deducted from the refund. No restocking fee applies to damaged, defective or
wrong-item returns.
6. How refunds are issued
Refunds are issued to the original payment method or as account credit, at the customer's choice.
Approved refunds are processed within 5 business days of the returned goods being received and

title: Returns & Refund Policy
text:
inspected. Credit notes appear in the customer's account immediately after approval.
7. Late-delivery interaction
If an order was delivered later than its Shipping SLA, the customer is entitled to a late-delivery credit
as set out in the Shipping & Delivery SLA (POL-SHP-002). A late-delivery credit is separate from, and
can be combined with, a refund under this policy. A customer whose order was more than 5 days late
may also return the whole order with no restocking fee, even if the goods were opened.
8. Approval authority
Support agents may approve refunds up to $2,500. Refunds above $2,500 require Support Team
Lead approval; refunds above $10,000 require the Director of Customer Operations.

If a shipment is delivered after its SLA, Brightline issues an account credit calculated as a percentage

Orders more than 5 days late additionally qualify for free return shipping and the option to return the

5. Carriers and tracking
Brightline ships with SwiftFreight, NorthStar Logistics and CityHaul Express. Tracking numbers are
emailed at shipment. Carrier delays caused by documented severe weather or road closures may be
excluded from the SLA at the discretion of the Logistics Manager; such exclusions must be recorded
on the shipment.
6. Damaged in transit
Damaged deliveries are handled under the Returns & Refund Policy (POL-RET-001). Customers
should report damage within 7 days of delivery.
7. Escalation
Customers with an order that is already 3 or more days past its SLA and not yet delivered should be
escalated as a Priority 2 (P2) ticket per the Customer Support Handbook (POL-SUP-004).

title: Pricing & Discount Policy
text:
Pricing & Discount Policy
Brightline Supplies Inc. | Document POL-PRC-003 | Version 3.2 | Effective 1 July 2025
1. Purpose
This policy sets out list pricing, volume discounts and the approval rules for discounts offered to B2B
customers.
2. List pricing
List prices are published in the product catalogue and are in US dollars, excluding tax and freight. List
prices are reviewed every January and July. Customers are given 30 days' notice of any list price
increase.
3. Volume discounts
A volume discount applies per product line, based on the quantity of that product on a single order:

4. Tier discounts
Customers in higher tiers receive an additional discount, applied on top of any volume discount:

Tier is reviewed annually. A customer moves to Gold after $150,000 in trailing twelve-month revenue
and to Platinum after $500,000, subject to account manager approval.
5. Stacking and caps
Volume and tier discounts stack, but the total discount on any line may not exceed 20%. Any
discount above 15% requires written approval from the Sales Director before the order is confirmed.
Discounts above 20% are not permitted under any circumstance.
6. Contract pricing

title: Pricing & Discount Policy
text:
Customers with an annual commitment of $250,000 or more may negotiate fixed contract prices for
up to 12 months. Contract prices replace volume discounts but not tier discounts, and are subject to
the same 20% cap relative to list.
7. Late-delivery credits are not discounts
Account credits issued under the Shipping & Delivery SLA are service credits. They do not count
toward the 20% discount cap and do not affect a customer's tier revenue calculation.
8. Payment terms
Standard payment terms are net 30. Platinum customers may request net 45. A 1% early-payment
discount applies when an invoice is paid within 10 days.

4. Handling a late-delivery ticket
Step 1: confirm the ship date, delivered date and SLA days on the shipment record. Step 2: calculate
days late (delivered date minus ship date, minus SLA days). Step 3: apply the compensation credit
from the SLA table (5%, 10% or 15%). Step 4: record the credit on the ticket and notify the customer.
Step 5: if more than 5 days late, offer free return shipping and a full return option.
5. Handling a damaged-item ticket
Confirm the claim was raised within 7 days of delivery, collect photographs, then offer the customer a
full refund or replacement. Brightline pays return shipping. Log the carrier so Logistics can raise a
carrier claim.

6. Escalation
Escalate to the Support Team Lead when: a refund exceeds $2,500, a customer has raised three or
more tickets in 30 days, or a P1 ticket has not been resolved within 4 hours. Escalate to the Director
of Customer Operations for refunds above $10,000 or any legal threat.
7. Quality standards

title: Customer Support Handbook
text:
All replies must be reviewed for tone and accuracy. Every closed ticket is followed by a one-question
satisfaction survey. The team's target is a customer satisfaction score of 92% or above and 95% of
tickets meeting their first-response target.

1. Product categories
Brightline Supplies sells five categories of office products to business customers: Furniture,
Electronics, Printers & Toner, Stationery and Breakroom. This guide summarises each category and
its warranty cover.

3. What the warranty covers
The warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal office use. Covered
remedies are repair, replacement or refund at Brightline's discretion. Brightline pays shipping on
warranty replacements within the first 12 months.
4. What the warranty excludes
Excluded: accidental damage, liquid damage, misuse, unauthorised repair or modification, normal
wear and tear (for example fabric wear on chairs), cosmetic damage that does not affect function, and
consumables once opened.

5. Making a warranty claim
Customers open a ticket with the issue type Warranty, with the order number, product, delivered date
and photographs. Claims are reviewed within 3 business days. Approved claims are fulfilled within the
shipping SLA for the customer's region.
6. Product safety and recalls
If a product is recalled, Brightline notifies affected customers within 48 hours and offers a full refund
or replacement, irrespective of warranty status or return window.
7. Sustainability

title: Product Catalog & Warranty Guide
